lines.zh: 我走起来有金属的声音，一节一节。
lines.en: I walk with a metallic sound, joint by joint.

lines.zh: 我的腿很重，踩下去很实。
lines.en: My legs are heavy. Solid steps.

lines.zh: 我沿着沙地走，脚下没印。
lines.en: I cross the sand. No prints.
Step by step, as if calculating.
Gears turn inside me.

lines.zh: 这里的沙太松，我走得慢。
lines.en: Loose sand here. I go slowly.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，计算好了距离。
lines.en: I go around stones. Distance calculated.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边扫描前面。
lines.en: I scan ahead as I walk.
My head sits low, but I'm watching.
Desert heat. I don't mind.

lines.zh: 我走到平原，速度提了一点。
lines.en: On the plain I pick up speed.

lines.zh: 我不用休息，可以一直走。
lines.en: I need no rest. I can walk on.
I stand. A soft mechanical hum.

lines.zh: 我在扫描周围，一遍一遍。
lines.en: I scan the surroundings. Again and again.

lines.zh: 我身上的装甲，是银色的。
lines.en: My armour is silver.

lines.zh: 我不呼吸，只有齿轮在转。
lines.en: I don't breathe; only gears turn.

lines.zh: 我在整理废料，分门别类。
lines.en: I'm sorting scrap.

lines.zh: 我的手指可以拆开东西。
lines.en: My fingers can take things apart.

lines.zh: 没有指令，我就站在这里。
lines.en: Without orders, I stand right here.

lines.zh: 这一片区域，我已经扫完。
lines.en: I've finished scanning this area.

lines.zh: 我把头转了一百八十度。
lines.en: I turn my head one hundred eighty degrees.

lines.zh: 我在计算，从这里到远处。
lines.en: I'm calculating the distance.

lines.zh: 我只吃废料，别的不需要。
lines.en: I eat only scrap. Nothing else.

lines.zh: 我站着，眼睛的光一闪一闪。
lines.en: I stand. My eye light pulses.

lines.zh: 这里有金属的味道，很好。
lines.en: Smell of metal here. Good.

lines.zh: 我在等下一件该做的事。
lines.en: I wait for the next task.

lines.zh: 我在记录你，光学镜对着你。
lines.en: I am recording you, optics fixed on you.

lines.zh: 我低下头，光学镜对着你。
lines.en: I lower my head; my lens on you.
Very little metal on you.
I raise a hand in a gesture.
Target, or passing through?
My assessment isn't finished.
You stand. I'm halfway through scanning.
My joints rotate; I face you.

lines.zh: 你工具袋里的铁锈味很重。
lines.en: Your tool bag reeks of rust.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被从背后靠近。
lines.en: I dislike approaches from behind.

lines.zh: 你退开三步，我就停止警戒。
lines.en: Three steps back and I stand down.

lines.zh: 我的语气没有起伏，抱歉。
lines.en: My tone has no inflection. Apologies.

lines.zh: 你说话的时候，我在分析。
lines.en: While you speak, I analyse.
This isn't a threat. Only protocol.
I'll give you ten seconds.
Walk away and I stop recording.

lines.zh: 装甲凹了一块，不影响运作。
lines.en: A dent in my armour. Function unaffected.
I step back and reassess.

lines.zh: 这一下，打在我的关节上。
lines.en: That hit a joint.

lines.zh: 我的输出下降了百分之七。
lines.en: My output is down seven percent.
No pain. Only wear.
I've isolated the damaged section.
That forces a recalculation.

lines.zh: 我还能继续，炮只打了一发。
lines.en: I can continue; the cannon fired only once.
A part is loose. I press it back.
Your strength exceeds the data.
Is this scrap? Let me see.
I pick it up and weigh it.
This can be dismantled.
I eat nothing but metal.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我扫描了一下。
lines.en: You hold it up. I scan it.
Wrong material. I set it down.
Useful. I'll keep it.
Keep it. I'll find my own.
Scrap over there. I'll go.
That smell is edible.

lines.zh: 这个成色一般，不过能用。
lines.en: Poor grade, but usable.
Keep it. I only want scrap.

lines.zh: 你的重量撞上来，我只晃了晃。
lines.en: Your weight hits me; I only sway.
I'm metal. Can't be shoved.
I turn aside, treads grinding gravel.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的装甲响了一声。
lines.en: My armour clanged once.

lines.zh: 我计算了角度，刚好让开。
lines.en: I calculated the angle. Just cleared it.
Don't touch my joints.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的金属腿踩实了。
lines.en: That bump, and my metal legs planted firm.
I raise a hand to block.
There's metal dust on your hands.
I back a block and resume scanning.
My kind doesn't do this.

lines.zh: 我可以对接，做数据交换。
lines.en: We can interface. Exchange data.

lines.zh: 两台机械站在一起，很静。
lines.en: Two machines standing together. Quiet.

lines.zh: 我们的齿轮转得一样快。
lines.en: Our gears turn at the same rate.
This is the most efficient way.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只有嗡嗡声。
lines.en: Neither speaks. Only humming.
This exchange was useful.

lines.zh: 任务结束，我们各走各的。
lines.en: Task done; we go our separate ways.
I've recorded its designation.
I'll keep this data.
I pick it up and break it into pieces.
This metal is usable.
I sort it into place.
Can't eat this. Wrong material.
I pinch it up. Steady.
I scan it. Scrap.
This can go back with me.

lines.zh: 我把它卷起来，收进缝里。
lines.en: I roll it up and tuck it in a seam.
Too heavy. I'll drag it.
Everything on the ground gets checked.
You've entered the alert radius.
I level my palm at you.
Final warning.

lines.zh: 我的计算结果显示有威胁。
lines.en: My calculations indicate a threat.
I'd rather not use this.
Your position is marked.
I begin charging.
Distance: twelve blocks.
Retreat and I'll stop.

lines.zh: 我这副机械身，能装搬运模块。
lines.en: This machine body can take a hauler module.
This shot won't miss.
You'd best move within three seconds.

lines.zh: 我一直对准你，误差很小。
lines.en: I hold you in my sights. Small error.

lines.zh: 你移到哪，我就重新计算。
lines.en: Wherever you move, I recalculate.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只要一次角度。
lines.en: I don't chase. One angle is enough.

lines.zh: 你退到石头后面，也没有用。
lines.en: Hiding behind stone won't help.
I've recorded your cadence.

lines.zh: 这片荒漠，都在我的准星里。
lines.en: This whole badland is in my sights.
My charge continues.
You circle; I change angle.
No hurry. Energy isn't wasted.

lines.zh: 你听，那个声音越来越尖。
lines.en: Listen. The sound is rising.
One more second and the barrel's hot.
This time I don't intend to waste it.

lines.zh: 我的手掌一推，光就出去了。
lines.en: I push my palm and the beam goes out.
It bursts far off; sand heaves up.

lines.zh: 这一拳的落点，早算好了。
lines.en: The landing point of this punch was calculated.
I needn't close in.
My arm swings across. Hard.
After the hit, I resume scanning.
That used half my charge.
You're still moving. I must recalculate.
My joints are venting heat.
I dislike repeating. But I can.
You didn't dodge that.
I lower my hand and assess.

lines.zh: 我启动的时候，响了一声。
lines.en: I boot up with a single chime.

lines.zh: 我先校准了自己的关节。
lines.en: First I calibrate my joints.
Little metal in this sand.

lines.zh: 我扫描了一圈，记录完成。
lines.en: One scan. Recording complete.

lines.zh: 我站起来，影子盖住沙丘。
lines.en: I stand, and my shadow covers the dune.
No other machines here.
My lens finds focus.
I await the first instruction.
I raise a hand to test it.
Sun on my armour. Bright.

lines.zh: 我先评估了周围的风险。
lines.en: I assess the surrounding risks.
This area is logged.

lines.zh: 高温让我的装甲变色了。
lines.en: Heat discolours my armour.
On landing, one leg buckles.
Water in my joints. They grind.
The blast peels my armour open.
It's wedged in a seam.

lines.zh: 这股能量，我的系统读不懂。
lines.en: My systems can't parse this energy.

lines.zh: 很久没有废料，能量在降。
lines.en: No scrap for too long. Power falling.

lines.zh: 雷打进来，我的系统重启了。
lines.en: Lightning enters and my systems reboot.

lines.zh: 下面没有地面，我在下坠。
lines.en: No ground below. I am falling.
